messages:
Maya Lin: Heads-up — AeroLoop (renewal ~4w) dropped to near-zero inference calls this morning. They were ~18k tokens/day last week. Flagging for renewal triage.
Priya Nair: Noted. Any evidence of billing or champion churn?
Omar Khan: Their ML lead was promoted last week; new infra lead started Mon. I see a support SR about a config rollback (SR-11011). Also procurement did a demo with Synthetix.ai yesterday — they liked the E2E deployment story.
Diego Ramos: Quick check: auth events show a batch of 403s starting 03/21 03:00 UTC. No 5xx signs. Looks like a token rotation or policy push.
Maya Lin: Likely causes: new infra/security policy revoked tokens, or devs switched to a local stub while they test Synthetix. Proposed play: 1) issue an IP-restricted short token (48h) so integration tests can resume, 2) offer a 30-min SE session + 30k token credit, 3) schedule a 20-min joint security/integration call.
Priya Nair: Agree. Keep outreach short and non-salesy. Also prep a tight TCO slide comparing us vs Synthetix focusing on latency, burst capacity, and ops overhead.
Omar Khan: SE note: add a tiny warmup snippet to reduce cold starts — paste in outreach.
Maya Lin: Warmup snippet:
```bash
curl -s -X POST https://api.redwood.ai/v1/engines/run \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer $TOKEN" \
  -d '{"prompt":"warmup","max_tokens":1}'
```
Priya Nair: I'll draft the outreach (<=150 words) and request the token. Also tag Legal if procurement asks for contract flex. ops-bot, please link SR-11011 to renewal task.
ops-bot: SR-11011 linked to renewal task AL-270. Priority set to HIGH by Priya Nair.
Diego Ramos: I'll own the TCO slide. Omar — can you be SE on the call and run a perf profile before the meeting? ETA EOD.
Omar Khan: Yep — will upload p95/p99 charts and a short config recommendation (prefix cache + batch_size 8).
Maya Lin: Draft outreach (short):
"Hi Alex — noticed API traffic stopped after your infra changes. We can issue an IP-limited 48h token and run a quick SE tune to get integration tests unblocked. Would 20 mins this week work to walk security and infra through the steps?
— Maya (CSM)"
Priya Nair: Looks good. I'll send it and follow up with the token. If calls don't resume within 7 days after the unblock, escalate to AE for exec outreach. Closing interim thread; will post call notes here.
